meta.name: description
meta.content: OmniX is the first community-owned concentrated liquidity marketplace driving ve(3,3) concept on @zksync. It drived the solidly concept of redistributing fees and token emissions to multiple roles with the features of staking, bribing and vote-escrowed tokens etc, involving community into the protocol to expand DeFi mission.
